options.name: client_override_options
options.description: Client override options (developer use). For example, can be used to override the DigitalOcean API endpoint for an internal test suite. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: engine
options.description:
A slug representing the database engine used for the cluster. The possible values are "pg" for PostgreSQL, "mysql" for MySQL, "valkey" for Valkey,
and "mongodb" for MongoDB.

options.name: module_override_options
options.description: Module override options (developer use). Can be used to override module options to support experimental or future options. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: name
options.description: A unique, human-readable name referring to a database cluster.

options.name: num_nodes
options.description: The number of nodes in the database cluster.

options.name: private_network_uuid
options.description:
A string specifying the UUID of the VPC to which the database cluster will be assigned. If excluded, the cluster when creating a new database cluster, it will be assigned to your
account's default VPC for the region.

options.name: project_id
options.description:
The ID of the project that the database cluster is assigned to. If excluded when creating a new database cluster, it will be assigned to your default
project.

options.name: region
options.description: The slug identifier for the region where the database cluster is located.

options.name: size
options.description: The slug identifier representing the size of the nodes in the database cluster.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the resource, C(present) to create, C(absent) to destroy.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags that have been applied to the database cluster.

options.name: token
options.description: DigitalOcean API token. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value. C(DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN), C(DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN), C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN)

options.name: version
options.description: A string representing the version of the database engine in use for the cluster.
